name: CTOS Digital Berhad
overview: CTOS Digital Berhad 在 2026 年完成了对 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 10% 股权的出售，交易对价为 RM50.0 million，该交易于 2026 年 7 月 29 日完成。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、新增或缩减事项。
overview_en: CTOS Digital Berhad completed the disposal of a 10% equity stake in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM50.0 million in 2026, with the transaction completed on 29 July 2026. No other business segment expansions, new businesses, or reductions were announced by the company.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司出售了在 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 10% 股权。
segments.note_en: The company disposed of its 10% equity interest in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售 Juris 10% 股权的交易于 2026 年 7 月 29 日完成。
actions.text_en: The disposal of the 10% equity interest in Juris was completed on 29 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: CTOS 与 Natsoft (M) Sdn Bhd 签订股份出售协议，以 RM50.0 million 现金出售 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 100,000 股普通股（占 10% 股权）。
actions.text_en: CTOS entered into a share sale agreement with Natsoft (M) Sdn Bhd to dispose of 100,000 ordinary shares in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd, representing 10% equity interest, for a total cash consideration of RM50.0 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司退出对 Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd 的 10% 股权投资。
model_changes.text_en: The company exited its 10% equity investment in Juris Technologies Sdn Bhd and no longer holds any equity interest in the company.
